imageUrl.description: Publicly fetchable reference image URL. Local files must be hosted first via aiasset:upload-image (returns a presigned COS URL).

modelType.description: Meshy mesh type, used ONLY when pipeline=raw. Ignored under pipeline=precise-lowpoly.

targetPolycount.description: Target polygon count. precise-lowpoly: low-poly remesh budget (default 1500). raw: only honored for modelType=standard (default 6000).

pipeline.description: Generation strategy. precise-lowpoly (default): standard generate → remesh to targetPolycount (triangle) → optional PBR retexture. raw: single-shot Meshy generate using modelType.
